Solo and Pro

Holler pricing

Holler has two plans, and you can pay for either one by the month or by the year.

Plans

Every plan starts with a 14-day free trial. No card needed.

  • Solo

    For one shop in one town.

    $7.99a month

    or $79.99 a year, save 16%

    • 1 service area: your ZIP code and how far you travel
    • Up to 5 trades
    • Alerts by email, at most one an hour
    • Your feed of matches
    • Reply to resident requests through Holler
    Start free for 14 days

  • Pro

    For a crew that covers more ground or more kinds of work.

    $13.99a month

    or $139.99 a year, save 16%

    • Up to 3 service areas: your ZIP code plus 2 more
    • Up to 15 trades
    • Up to 5 keyword watches, such as "tree removal"
    • Alerts by email, at most one an hour
    • Your feed of matches
    • Reply to resident requests through Holler
    Start free, pick Pro later

The trial uses Solo limits. Move to Pro in Settings, or cancel, any time. Push alerts arrive with the iPhone and Android apps, which are on the way.

Pay yearly on either plan and you save 16%.

Billing questions

Do I need a card to try it?
No. The free trial lasts 14 days with no card, and it runs on Solo limits: one ZIP code and up to 5 trades while you try it.
What happens when the trial ends?
Your feed locks unless you subscribe. We never charge you just because a trial ended, and if you subscribe on the website during the trial, the first charge comes when it ends. A plan you buy in the app is charged by Apple or Google when you buy it.
Can I cancel any time?
Yes. Choose Manage billing in Settings and cancel there, which stops the next charge, and your plan stays on until the end of the period you already paid for.
Can I switch between Solo and Pro?
Yes, in Settings. Moving up to Pro charges your card right away for the days left in your billing period, and if that charge fails, nothing changes. Moving down to Solo turns the unused part of Pro into a credit on your next bill. Your extra areas, trades beyond 5 and keyword watches then stop being used, but they stay saved for later. Either way, you move to the current price of the plan you pick.
Do you give refunds?
Payments are final. We do not refund part of a month or year, except where the law requires it or a plan change is prorated. If you think we charged you by mistake, write to us and we will look into it.
What is a keyword watch?
A keyword watch is a phrase you pick, such as "tree removal", and Pro gets up to 5 of them. Holler sends you any record in your areas whose title or summary has that phrase, even when it falls outside your trades.

The full rules are in the terms.
